name: pidasgif
description: Create an animated GIF to simulate a passenger information display

scripts.postinstall: cp node_modules/html2canvas/dist/html2canvas.js third-party/html2canvas/html2canvas.js && cp node_modules/html2canvas/dist/html2canvas.min.js third-party/html2canvas/html2canvas.min.js && cp node_modules/html2canvas/dist/html2canvas.esm.js third-party/html2canvas/html2canvas.esm.js && cp node_modules/gif.js/dist/gif.js third-party/gif-js/gif.js && cp node_modules/gif.js/dist/gif.worker.js third-party/gif-js/gif.worker.js

notes.webm-writer: Kept vendored at 0.3.0 — the npm package (1.0.0) is CommonJS-only and requires a bundler
